author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: AI can't help me write this book.  ChatGPT still talks about the code review bottleneck.  It is so 2025.  Oh right, the training data cut off is early 2026.  AI doesn't know what's next problem after we solved the code review bottleneck and archived the 3-5x productivity gain.
